density_contract.formula_for_v2: DEN is real32(1)/(AL+ALB), authoritative dry-air density; use DEN directly.

first_call_v17_identity.scope: First KDM6 call only; matching hashes do not alter incomplete timestep-2 result.

PRE_KDM6_state.NR_unit_basis: Host scalar passed as number_per_kg to specific_number_to_volume by KDM6 wrapper; direct wrapper-to-callee conversion confirmed in source.

rain_freezing_ledger.interpretation: NR in KDM6 is converted from host number-per-kg-dry to number-per-m3 before the 2-D call (specific_number_to_volume(nr,dry_density,number_value), then nrs=number_value; module_mp_kdm6.F lines 1380-1385, 1440-1448); this packet NR value is downstream of intervening KDM6 processes and is not identical to PRE_KDM6 NR.
rain_freezing_ledger.row: PR85_RAIN_FREEZE 114 2 18 1 FF theta=0; QR_before=7.9431267119289828e-10 kg/kg-dry; NR_before=1.7165578603744507 #/m3; QG_before=0; BG_before=0; base_valid=F; accepted=F.

rain_freezing_rejection_context.scope: Second PRE_KDM6 state and corresponding rain-freezing packet rejection; fields are separate representations at separate points in the call.

source_mapping.actual_arg: module_mp_kdm6.F:1455-1473 calls kdm62D; module_mp_kdm6.F:1462 passes `j` in the lat argument position.
source_mapping.dummy: module_mp_kdm6.F:1648-1655 declares callee dummy lat; module_mp_kdm6.F:1765 declares integer, INTENT(IN).
source_mapping.interpretation: For this wrapper call, ledger lat=2 maps directly to host j=2. It is a column index, not a separately inferred geographical latitude.

scope: Independent completed-state Q/N/B, PSD-cone, dry-density conversion, and entry-cap checks per timestep; rules are delegated to PR85 helpers.

timestep2_predictor_vs_endpoint.scope: Per-stage total-water field checks distinguish generic PRE_RK/RK predictions from the completed RK3/PRE_KDM6 endpoint; no Q/V correction was applied.
